content:
Class 5 money questions graduate to profit & loss and discounts — the first taste of commercial maths. Here is what the Maths Olympiad Class 5 money chapter tests, the facts, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 5 Maths Olympiad Money chapter tests

  • Money arithmetic with decimals
  • Unit cost, better buys and bills
  • Profit and loss (CP vs SP)
  • Discounts off the marked price

Key facts your child should know

  • Profit = SP − CP; Loss = CP − SP.
  • Unit cost = total ÷ number; compare per-unit to find the better buy.
  • Discount is taken off the marked price: 20% off ₹450 → ₹360.
  • Line up decimal points in every money sum.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Swapping CP and SP.
  • Taking the discount percent of the wrong amount.
  • Forgetting paise digits when subtracting.

quiz.title: IMO Class 5 Money Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: Rs 1200 is taken as a savings deposit at 10% simple interest per year for 5 years. What total amount must be paid back?
Zoya buys 2 kg of oranges at Rs 75 each and 1 melon at Rs 60 each and pays with a Rs 500 note. How much change should Zoya get back?
A dozen bananas cost Rs 84. What is the cost of 30 bananas at the same rate?
questions.explanation: One banana costs 84 ÷ 12 = Rs 7. Cost of 30 bananas = 30 × 7 = Rs 210.

questions.q: In how many years will Rs 2000 earn Rs 480 as simple interest at 8% per year?
A carpenter bought a dining table for Rs 4800 but could sell it only for Rs 4320. What is the loss per cent?
Deepak lends Rs 4800 at 7% simple interest per year for 2 years. Find the simple interest.
A dealer bought a second-hand TV for Rs 5000 and sold it for Rs 5750. What is the profit per cent?
questions.explanation: Profit = SP − CP = Rs 5750 − Rs 5000 = Rs 750. Profit% = profit/CP × 100 = 750/5000 × 100 = 15%.

questions.q: Ramesh deposits Rs 2000 in a bank at 5% simple interest per year for 3 years. How much interest is earned?
Nita buys a water purifier for Rs 5600 and wants to earn a profit of 25%. At what price must she sell it?
Rs 2500 is put into a seed loan at 8% simple interest per year for 3 years. What is the total amount at the end?

faq.q: What is the difference between profit and loss?
faq.a: Profit when selling price exceeds cost price (SP − CP); loss when cost exceeds selling (CP − SP).

faq.q: How do you find the price after a 20% discount?
faq.a: Find 20% of the marked price and subtract: ₹450 − ₹90 = ₹360.
